purpose: V2 dispatcher for the USDS prime token. On dispatch it (a) wraps the pooling portion of USDS into sUSDS (ERC4626 deposit) and (b) attempts a failure-isolated USDS->USDC donation via the Sky PSM to batchMinter (story-034). Accumulated sUSDS is later added as single-sided liquidity to a Balancer V3 sUSDS/phUSD pool via pool(minBPT) by an authorized pooler (pure LP add). Receives and custodies BPT.

verifiedProperties.pauseMechanism: OZ Pausable inherited; pool() is whenNotPaused; _dispatch path is whenNotPaused via base; rescueERC20 intentionally NOT pause-gated

localFindings.description: The donation sweep (`balanceOf(USDS)`) only runs when donationEnabled (batchMinter && psm && batchDonationSize>0). If a prior donation parked USDS on the contract and the owner THEN disables the donation (set batchMinter=0 / size=0), the stranded USDS is neither swept nor wrapped: subsequent _dispatch wraps only `amount` (poolingUSDS == amount) and the previously-parked USDS sits idle until donation is re-enabled or rescueERC20 is called. Funds are recoverable (owner escape hatch), so this is a low-severity accounting wrinkle, not a loss.
localFindings.recommendation: Optionally always sweep/wrap residual USDS, or document that owner must rescueERC20 stranded USDS before disabling the donation.

localFindings.description: gemAmt = floor(usdsAmount*WAD / (conv*(WAD+tout))); usdsSpent recomputed from gemAmt (<= usdsAmount). Rounding is FLOOR on USDC out, so the contract never over-spends USDS and dust (usdsAmount - usdsSpent) parks for the next sweep. require(gemAmt > 0) reverts on sub-unit donations -> caught by try/catch -> parks. Math mirrors DssLitePsm._buyGem. Rounding favors the protocol (no over-credit). Verified internally consistent.
localFindings.recommendation: None. Confirm conv/tout semantics against the live PSM in interaction analysis.

localFindings.description: Donation is isolated via `try this._psmDonate(remaining) {} catch { emit DonationSkipped }`. _psmDonate is external, gated `require(msg.sender == address(this))`. It is invoked while the base dispatch holds the nonReentrant lock; _psmDonate itself is not nonReentrant (it cannot be, being a self-call under the lock). The PSM.buyGem external call could in principle re-enter, but dispatch/pool are nonReentrant so re-entry into the value paths is blocked. The only non-guarded external entry reachable mid-call is _psmDonate (self-gated) — confirm in interaction analysis that PSM cannot trigger an unguarded state-changing path.
localFindings.recommendation: Interaction analysis: model PSM as semi-trusted external; confirm reentrancy containment.

localFindings.description: The donation sweeps the FULL USDS balance (this dispatch's share + any stranded), but the base class then calls hook.onDispatch with the GROSS `amount` of THIS dispatch only. So phUSD mint-debt (BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook) accrues on the gross per-dispatch USDS, independent of how much USDS was actually donated/parked. This is intended (debt tracks dispatched volume, not donation success) but couples two independent percentages (batchDonationSize for USDC donation vs hook.ratio for phUSD debt). Economic soundness is an econ-scanner concern.
localFindings.recommendation: Flag for econ-scanner: relationship between batchDonationSize, hook.ratio, sUSDS pooled, and phUSD minted.

stateChanges: sUSDS transferred to vault, BPT minted to this
externalEntryPoints.reentrancyGuard: inherits dispatch/pool guard (only reachable via pool's unlock)

externalEntryPoints.notes: NOT pause-gated (escape hatch must work during pause).

externalCalls.notes: _primeToken == sUSDS.asset() == USDS, read once in ctor.
Donation route. tout ceiling = maxTout. Failure isolated in try/catch.
unlock/settle transient-accounting pattern; unlockCallback gated to vault.

valueFlows: DISPATCH: USDS arrives on contract (minter transferFrom). poolingUSDS = amount - donationUSDS wrapped to sUSDS (held). donationUSDS portion (plus any stranded USDS) -> PSM.buyGem -> USDC delivered directly to batchMinter. On PSM failure the USDS parks and retries next dispatch. hook.onDispatch(gross amount) accrues phUSD mint-debt.
POOL: authorized pooler triggers pool(minBPT) -> all accumulated sUSDS single-sided-added to Balancer V3 pool -> BPT minted to this contract. minBPT is slippage floor.
WITHDRAW: owner withdrawBPT to recipient; owner rescueERC20 any token (incl. parked USDS / sUSDS / BPT).
invariants: poolingUSDS + donationUSDS == amount; donationUSDS == 0 when donation disabled (full amount wrapped).
_psmDonate spends <= swept USDS; USDC out is floor-rounded (never over-credits batchMinter).
buyGem only executes when tout <= maxTout (else reverts -> caught -> USDS parks).
pool() and dispatch() are mutually non-reentrant (shared OZ ReentrancyGuard).
Donation never reverts the mint (try/catch isolation) — story-034 core property.
pool() performs only an LP add, no swap/donation (story-034: pool() is a pure LP add).
trustAssumptions: sUSDS is the canonical Sky ERC4626 over USDS; deposit() yields proportional sUSDS with no donation-attack vector that harms this single-depositor contract beyond standard 4626 risk.
psm is the canonical Sky UsdsPsmWrapper (USDS<->USDC); tout governance-settable but bounded by owner maxTout.
Balancer V3 vault honors the unlock/addLiquidity/settle accounting; unlockCallback only invoked by vault.
Owner sets _pool to a real sUSDS/phUSD pool with the correct token ordering (_sUSDSIsFirst).
batchMinter, poolers, and owner are trusted; phUSD mint-debt accounting handled by the separate hook.
